title: Argo CD SSO with Casdoor: OIDC and RBAC Setup
headline: Single sign-on for Argo CD
summary: Argo CD can use an existing OpenID Connect provider directly, without its bundled Dex. With Casdoor, people sign in to the Argo CD UI and CLI with their Casdoor account, and Casdoor groups decide what they can do.
redirectNote: The second URL is for `argocd login --sso` from the CLI.

steps.title: Store the client secret
steps.text: Put the client secret in the `argocd-secret` Secret, where `oidc.config` can reference it.

steps.title: Configure OIDC in argocd-cm
steps.text: Add Casdoor to the `argocd-cm` ConfigMap. Casdoor puts the user's groups in the ID token, which is where Argo CD reads them.

code.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: argocd-cm
  namespace: argocd
data:
  url: {{appUrl}}
  oidc.config: |
    name: Casdoor
    issuer: {{casdoorUrl}}
    clientID: {{clientId}}
    clientSecret: $oidc.casdoor.clientSecret
    requestedScopes: ["openid", "profile", "email"]
    enablePKCEAuthentication: true

steps.title: Grant permissions by group
steps.text: Map Casdoor groups to Argo CD roles in `argocd-rbac-cm`. Here members of `argocd-admins` get full access and everyone else can only look.

code.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: argocd-rbac-cm
  namespace: argocd
data:
  policy.default: role:readonly
  policy.csv: |
    g, argocd-admins, role:admin
  scopes: "[groups]"

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: The Argo CD login page now has a **Log in via Casdoor** button, and `argocd login argocd.example.com --sso` opens Casdoor in the browser.

tips: Argo CD reads `oidc.config` changes without a restart, but users have to sign in again to pick up new group memberships.

faqs.question: Do I still need Dex?
faqs.answer: No. With `oidc.config`, Argo CD talks to Casdoor directly, and you can leave Dex unconfigured.

faqs.question: Can the argocd CLI sign in through Casdoor?
faqs.answer: Yes. `argocd login <server> --sso` opens the browser and receives the result on `http://localhost:8085/auth/callback`, which is why that URL is in the Casdoor application.
